title: Day 8. 2 a.m. Checking their page.
caption: 2 a.m., visit 61 to their page. Checking keeps the ache open. Muting them isn't a punishment, it's rest. Charge the phone across the room and let yourself sleep. Send this to the friend still awake and scrolling.
